stops.note: literally chosen or select, describing fine goat-hair cloth
from Arabic 'mukhayyar', choice cloth; made from the hair of the Angora goat of Ankara
carried the fabric name into French trade vocabulary
settled as the word for fine cloth woven from Angora goat hair
stops.meaning: fabric woven from Angora goat hair

current_meaning: a fabric or yarn made from the hair of the Angora goat
